notes_for_editor: Only Alberta's own open-data record and three Alberta pages were usable. Several searches found no history, fire, construction or public-access source for Pinto, so the story is short. The brief's built year (2019), 30 m height and 1,044.0 m elevation match the record; no corrections. Do not link this lookout to Pinto Lake (Banff/Jasper area, with the old Sunset Fire Lookout nearby): the name is shared, the record's coordinates are far from that lake, and no source ties them together. Access is left out of facts: the brief's 'closed' level and its 'staffed March-October' and 'please don't visit uninvited' wording do not appear in any cached Alberta page and were not repeated. The layer description (footnote 4) says the data is classed Protected and should not be shown on public maps larger than 1:1,000,000 or on maps with local roads; check the coordinates on Firefinder's map against that.
